name: Lovers shell
source:
Take the shoes of a young high school student in an anime inspired world as she interacts with strange people. Will any of them pull your heartstrings ? Where does her heart lies ? The answer depends on you. 

[From [url=https://team-dream-treasure.itch.io/lovers-shell]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以一位年轻高中生的鞋子为例，她在动漫世界中与陌生人互动。他们中的任何一个会牵动你的心弦吗？她的心在哪里？答案取决于你。

[来自[url=https://team-dream-treasure.itch.io/lovers-shell]Itch.io[/url]]
